The '''Imperial Citizenship Bureau''' was the organization charged with keeping records of all citizens of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. This bureau fell under the purview of the [[Ministry of Logistics]].

The name "[[Raina Temple]]" did not exist in any of their files.
